frozen_decision_thresholds.independent_item_coding: unanimous fit-positive only when both reviewers rate >=4 and neither abstains; unanimous fit-negative only when both rate <=2; all other responses stay mixed/indeterminate with both rows preserved
frozen_decision_thresholds.listening: require exact recording identity plus per-track license, permitted provider URL and region/date access status
frozen_decision_thresholds.maps: judge neighborhood utility separately from layout and retain unpositioned alternatives
frozen_decision_thresholds.membership: report fit at broad/subgenre/micro scope and confidence; use this cohort only for calibration/development, then freeze any score threshold before a disjoint confirmation cohort
frozen_decision_thresholds.neighbors: record cultural and sonic relevance separately; method preference is supported only by an explicit reviewer choice, while ties, neither, unsure and unsupported stay separate; no aggregate promotion threshold before confirmation
frozen_decision_thresholds.recordings: separate fit and diversity from popularity; unavailable is not a negative quality rating

limitations: The roster is a selected 150-artist engineering cohort, not a sample of world music.
Region, language and era are unknown for every roster item and remain explicit.
Only exact credited recording evidence present in the frozen projection is attached; absence means no cohort recording was supplied, not absence from an artist's discography.
Listening provider permission and current availability have not been verified.
No reviewer identities, judgments, or access outcomes are populated.

provider_destination_receipt.scope: exact MusicBrainz recording IDs mapped to literal provider destinations; availability and listening permission not checked

review_design.adjudication: retain both original judgments; adjudication is a separate record
review_design.method_blinding: candidate methods use randomized A/B labels; assignment key withheld during judgments

sampling.algorithm: Python random.Random; round-robin across evidence-volume tercile x direct-genre observed/missing; shuffled presentation
sampling.evidence_volume: count of direct claims, exact credited recordings, and outbound links in source projection
sampling.regions_languages_eras: unknown retained because source roster has no such observations; no geographic or linguistic representativeness claim

thresholds.direct_genre: source projection has at least one direct genre identifier

scope: selected-150-artist open-build review cohort; does not certify global coverage or legacy parity
